name: Head of Wealth Risk, International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), HSBC-India (INM)
posting_name: Head of Wealth Risk, International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), HSBC-India (INM)
job_description:
We’re seeking a senior risk professional to join our team as Head of Wealth Risk, International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), HSBC-India (INM)

 

Role Purpose

  • The Head of Wealth Risk is the senior second-line risk leader for the Wealth business in INM. The role provides independent, forward-looking oversight and challenge across financial and non-financial risks, enabling sustainable growth while ensuring that the Wealth strategy, products, services and distribution journeys operate within Group, India risk appetite, policy and regulatory expectations.
  • The role holder acts as trusted adviser to the INM IWPB Risk Head and independently represents Wealth Risk in key governance forums and provides an enterprise-wide view of the Wealth risk profile. The role is accountable for effective risk governance, escalation, transformation and reporting, and for aligning market activity with Regional and Global IWPB/Wealth Risk priorities. Wealth Risk remit in INM includes both Retail and Private Banking client segments. 
  • The role holder will provide strategic and governance oversight for IWPB Wealth Initiatives delivered through separate legal entities for Retail Broking and GIFT City. Day-to-day risk management will remain with the relevant business/entity.

 

Principal Accountabilities

In partnership with the INM IWPB Risk Head:

  • Own the aggregated Wealth risk view for INM including top and emerging risks, risk appetite, risk maps, key indicators, issues, stress testing and scenario analysis.
  • Provide independent input and challenge at Governance forums to execute the Risk Strategy and Risk Appetite (ensuring alignment with Group Risk Appetite where necessary)
  • Guide the implementation of the Group Risk Policies across Wealth, including any local exceptions to Group Risk Policy with relevant Risk Function Heads
  • Oversee the launch and ongoing management of investment and wealth products, services and distribution journeys, including new-product due diligence, suitability and fair value considerations, third-party dependencies and read-across across channels and customer segments.
  • Provide oversight guidance of the implementation and ongoing effectiveness of risk management and associated procedures and controls across Wealth, including the assessment of vulnerabilities through stress-testing and scenario analysis
  • Provide oversight guidance implementation of strategic risk related projects and coordination of the risk transformation agenda across Wealth, developing a cohesive programme and approach and ensuring changes in one area do not adversely impact another
  • Maintain effective relationships with Wealth Business leadership, specialist second-line teams, Internal Audit and regulators and other external stakeholders.
  • Lead, develop and deploy Wealth Risk resources effectively, building a high-performing and inclusive team and a strong network of risk professionals across disciplines.
  • Promote a strong risk and compliance culture, clearly communicating Risk Strategy, Policies and Appetite and reinforcing first-line ownership of risk.
  • Support the business and Risk in market in the achievement of sustainable growth aspirations, by enabling the business to take risk appropriately and identifying opportunities for immediate and long term growth based on a detailed understanding of strategy, risk profile, products and markets in which the business operates in Wealth.
  • Partner with India Wealth and Private Bank leadership to enable the controlled growth of capabilities through GIFT providing early risk input into strategic plans, products, services, client propositions and journeys.
  • Provide independent second-line oversight and challenge for the Retail Broking proposition offered through HISL.
  • Maintain effective relationships with INM IWPB Head, INM CRO and key stakeholders across legal entities.

 

 

Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications

 

Qualifications:

  • Typical qualifications would include a post-graduate degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Law or a related field
  • Fluency in spoken and written business English

 

Experience:

  • Significant senior risk leadership experience in private banking, wealth management or a comparable regulated financial-services environment
  • Strong understanding of investment and wealth products, product governance and distribution frameworks; experience across more than one risk discipline is preferred.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment
  • Experience in more than one technical risk discipline

 

Technical Knowledge:

  • Deep knowledge of risk governance, risk appetite, the Risk Management Framework and financial and non-financial risk policies.
  • Strong understanding of the local regulatory, legal, political, economic and competitive environment affecting Wealth.

 

Behavioural Capabilities:

  • Proven ability to advise and challenge senior executives, navigate a complex matrix and influence across market, regional and global stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial judgement, conceptual thinking and analytical capability, with the ability to translate complex information into clear decisions and executive briefings.
  • Demonstrated leadership of high-performing teams and complex transformation programmes.

 

Opening up a world of opportunity 

 

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. 

Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited.
